# affected-tests

> Select the Python test files affected by changed files using a static ast import graph, with conservative run-all triggers Python package `trysac-affected-tests`, import name `affected_tests`, MIT licensed,
> Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.

- [README](README.md): problem, install, usage example

- [Architecture](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): shape of the package and its public API
- [Testing](docs/TESTING.md): how to run and extend the tests
